title: The Negro Motorist Green Book: 1937
historical_context: Published in 1937 by Victor H. Green in New York City (16 pages, price 25 cents). While the 1936 first edition has no known surviving copies in public archives, this 1937 volume is the earliest extant edition, covering the New York metropolitan area, Westchester, and northern New Jersey.
